events.verdict: Jones (CHI) places both hands on Ingram (TOR) on the perimeter and the contact is marginal.
Jones (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Ingram (TOR) in the post and grazes his arm as he reaches in.
Smith (CHI) releases away from Ingram (TOR) after the pick.
Smith (CHI) steps out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.

Simons (CHI) wraps his left arm around Murray-Boyles' (TOR) side and initiates illegal contact. The illegal contact occurs prior to the start of Murray-Boyles' upward shooting motion and should have been deemed a non-shooting foul.
Quickley (TOR) extends an arm forward as he defends Simons (CHI) on the perimeter, but the contact is marginal.
Murray-Boyles (TOR) legally contests Simons' (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Giddey (CHI) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Barrett's (TOR) arm.
Barnes (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position and Giddey (CHI) loses control of the ball on his own as he attempts to split the defenders.
